about: What the M7 redraws still draw unlike their code sprites after migration batch M7c, measured (town-guard's side clips under shift and pike, void-ranger's end-on gun, mage-walker's cast at the frame's edge). shift: pixels off the code over the clip (idle_side, walk_side) at each look, before M7c (the figure never moved) and now (its root moved sideways by Length and weapon: travel on root.0). Read by tests/unit/m7-topdown-gestures.test.mjs, which holds each count to its ceiling (now) and lowers no ceiling silently.

shift.how: The code fits a long pole weapon into the frame by moving the whole figure sideways (rigs/topdown.js fit), by +3 px at Length 0.65 to -5 px at 1.35 for the halberd (measured against the default, per frame 2 to 5 px either way); the pike moves less (+3 to -4). The data scales its pole side clips' root.0 keys (the code's own shift at Length 1) by Length, a factor fitted to the code's pixels for the halberd at each step of the slider (0 to 2.25, held at 2.25 from 1.3: further, the tallest look with a kettle hat touches the frame's edge, which the code clips), and the spear's by 0.6 of that (one factor for every Length: Length 1.15 draws further from the code than with no move, 842 to 1381 and 1064 to 1665).
shift.block: block is not moved: the code moves the planted guard -3 px only from Length 1.2 (halberd) or 1.35 (spear), on some frames: block at Length 1.35 is 2111 (halberd) and 2159 (spear) pixels off the code.

rangerEndOn.how: void-ranger's gun seen end on (shoot_down frames 0 to 4, gunEnd): the code draws it at F.hand(J) of its braced frame, the data at the base's handF, which the baker keyed at the weapon hand: 0.2 to 0.8 px right and 0.1 to 0.8 px up of the code's point (frame 2: code 23.18, 26.82; data 24, 26), so the end-on gun stands a pixel right and its lit cell a row up, where the glove (gloveF-down, z 62.6) covers it, as the code's glove does not. The code also rims the gun where it lies over the suit (drawOver, RIM); the data draws no rim. Pixels off the code over shoot_down frames 0 to 4 at Length 1, per weapon. A fix needs a base whose reachF starts at the code's F.hand (a new base version) and a rim the renderer cannot draw over the body alone.

mageCast.how: mage-walker's cast light kept off the frame's edge (tools/bake-topdown-m7.mjs --fit cast-edges): where the code's light reaches the edge the code clips it, its ring stops growing at the edge (engine/fx.js ring) and a twinkle shows in part; the data leaves out the rows and columns of the burst and ring that would touch the edge (the ring keeps its size), leaves a twinkle out whole, and shows the resting glow for a staff at Length 1.225 and up with Height 0.997 and up. The ring's leftmost column (5 px) is left out from Length 0.925 at Build 0.785 and up. Pixels off the code over the cast clip before M7c's fit (no light at all from Height 0.55) and after, at the looks of tests/fixtures/m7-topdown-pixels.json and a few more: the staff at Height 1 and at Length 1.35 is a little further (light drawn where the code's is a row or two off and its ring smaller), every other look nearer.

pike.how: The code's pike is 23 x Length px and keeps growing to Length 1.35 (31.05 px); the data's stops at Length 1.15 (25.5714 px): longer, its head leaves the frame's top in the base's upright carry, where the code shortens or moves it frame by frame.
